direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; keep interactive targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for the stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the logo duplicate inside the right inspector; keep only header and opening-story placements at native aspect.
Enlarge the Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 tracks, align their start edges, and place DOES NOT MATCH directly across the 40-unit gap.
Add a visible focus ring to evidence rows and link row hover/focus to the matching SVG bar and job nodes in both directions.
Give ROUTE HEALTH · PRE-FLIGHT and INVESTIGATION · SOURCE EVIDENCE separate bordered regions, statuses and controls so nonce/identity health is never read as starting the investigation.
Refit the factory stage to use the empty lower area: increase machine and label scale within 1366x768 without reducing any target below 36px.
Make the primary read Run Sample investigation only after route choice is confirmed, and show the chosen route name in its aria-label.
Tighten consent spacing so the typed phrase field, 0/27 status and disabled Accept control are all fully visible without inspector scroll at 768px height.
Align 83h/35h/17.5h and cost columns in a tabular grid and keep Selected path marked by text and shape, not colour alone.
Mirror the selected option on the SVG with an Accepted marker and a single 240ms trace only when selection changes.
Correct the status line to show the real prior blocked count visible for this state, and keep the 3 proposed tasks labelled PROPOSED · UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL until Approve is pressed.
Stop the MAT-ALLOY-B label and route line colliding with JOB-1001; offset the label above the line and enlarge job labels.
Use an internal task-list scroll with a visible bottom fade and keep Decline proposal plus the primary action reachable without page scroll.
Show CELL-MILL-2 preview as dashed silver with PREVIEW · WILL GO OFFLINE; reserve red only for after the shock is applied.
Widen the machine selector to at least 44px height with a clear focus ring and expose the selected cell name in the DecisionBar status.
Reduce copy in the right panel to one instruction and one consequence sentence so the Apply control remains the sole primary.
Make the red OFFLINE-STOPPED cell legible: keep red outline and cross-hatch, raise its label to silver on black, and ensure no feasible route enters it.
Separate pre-flight route health from the investigation task with distinct headings and place the Reinvestigate primary only in the DecisionBar, not repeated in the inspector.
Align the constrained-option note under Split available capacity so 3 → 2 feasible paths is readable at a glance in the SVG footer.
Refit the inspector so the revised typed consent field, character count and disabled Accept revised decision are visible together within 768px; compress option cards before shrinking text.
Render the constrained Split option hatched and unselectable with FINISH and INCREMENTAL shown as em dashes plus a text reason.
Add PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED status as text and marker in both inspector and DecisionBar centre, not colour alone.
Keep Prior tracked work · 3 BLOCKED and 3 proposed replacements in two labelled groups, with an approved recovery plan note visible while replacements await approval.
Fix the MAT-ALLOY-B route label overlap over JOB-1001 and keep both 40 via CELL-MILL-1 and 30 via CELL-MILL-1 labels outside node boxes.
Reveal the cut-off third proposed task with internal scroll, a scroll-end marker and Decline kept sticky at the panel foot.
Sequence Verify, passphrase and Export as numbered locked steps with disabled states explained in text, so Export independent checkpoint cannot appear available before sealing.
Add a show/hide control and strength hint for the passphrase field while keeping the 16-160 character rule as the only guidance sentence.
Keep the primary as Verify ledger in the DecisionBar and demote the duplicate inspector Verify button to a secondary outline style.
Replace the active primary slot with a single completion status and Back only; add a labelled final state PACKET SEALED with 18 events and the retained offline cell.
Mark all three retained-evidence steps Complete with check text and remove any remaining pointer style from non-interactive sealed rows.
Add keyboard focus order from rail completion item to the sealed packet summary and announce completion once via aria-live polite.
